scope: Standing Çamlıca Mosque above Üsküdar, opened in 2019, with the six minarets, central prayer hall, domed courtyard colonnades and central ablution pavilion.

originalReview.notes: The standing mosque is visible slightly left of the near bridge tower. The distant original shows the cascaded large and subordinate domes between slender minarets above a nearly continuous low lit base.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact 2024 Qualla CC0 skyline photograph shows the dome and minarets. The footprint and official built measurements govern all principal dimensions.
